walkthroughs.body_html:
Component 2: Externally Set Assignment — a core area of GCSE Art & Design.

Working through it builds the schema you need: the key terms, how they connect, and how to use them together.

Component 2: Externally Set Assignment brings together several ideas you need to use as a set, not in isolation.

Lock in the vocabulary first, then practise pulling the ideas together to answer real questions.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Component 2: Externally Set Assignment.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.

mcqs.q: Which technique uses crossing lines for tone?
options: Stippling
Cross-hatching
Smudging
Tracing
Lines
Dots
Circles
Squares

mcqs.q: What can line in a composition imply, even without representing an object?
options: Only the outline of an object.
Movement, direction, emotion, and visual rhythm.
Just measurements.
Black, white, and grey.

mcqs.q: What are the three primary colours in paint (subtractive)?
options: Black, white, and grey.
Red, yellow, and blue (or magenta, yellow, cyan in print).
Red, green, and blue.
Cool colours like blue.

mcqs.q: Which colours typically advance in a composition?
options: Black, white, and grey.
Dark colours always advance.
Warm colours (reds, oranges, yellows).
Cool colours like blue.
